allowBargeIn.description: Whether users can interrupt TTS output with speech input. This only enables prompt interruption mechanically; it does not redefine the dialog's activation rule. Runtimes MUST require surface-eligible input/command evidence before treating the interruption as a command failure or consuming retry budget. When omitted, runtimes SHOULD fall back to the merged catalog/application value before any intrinsic runtime default.

noInputTimeoutMs.description: No-input timeout in milliseconds while listening. The timeout applies only while no surface-eligible input/command attempt has been evidenced; raw acoustic onset, playback leakage, or transcripts without the required activation signal MUST NOT end the timeout by themselves. When omitted, runtimes SHOULD fall back to the merged catalog/application timeout before any intrinsic runtime default. If 0, runtimes MAY treat this as disabled.

noInputMaxRetries.description: Maximum number of consecutive no-input/non-recognition retries before escalating. Retries may only be consumed by true no-input/non-recognition outcomes after applying the owning dialog's activation rule; playback leakage or transcripts without the required activation signal MUST NOT consume this budget. When omitted, runtimes SHOULD fall back to the merged catalog/application retry budget before any intrinsic runtime default.

sttMinConfidenceToAccept.description: Minimum STT confidence percentage (0..100) to accept input without additional confirmation. Default: 85.

sttMinConfidenceToConfirm.description: Minimum STT confidence percentage (0..100) to treat input as usable with confirmation. Default: 65. Below this, runtimes SHOULD treat input as not usable.

speechRate.description: Default TTS speech-rate multiplier for this form. When set, this overrides the merged catalog/application speechRate for the form dialog.

pauseAfterPromptMs.description: Pause in milliseconds after a prompt before the system starts listening.

Id.description: Identifier: starts with letter/underscore, followed by alphanumerics, dots, dashes, or underscores.

SpeechRate.description: TTS speech-rate multiplier (0.5-2.0). Documented presets: slow=0.7, normal=1.0, fast=1.3.

DiacriticsStrategy.description: How diacritics should be handled/canonicalized in voice-first flows. Default: preserve. Values: preserve, preferDiacritics, preferAscii.

FormVoiceProfileReference.description: Reference to a standalone form voice profile.
